newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Digitel sees H1 net almost doubling.
newsitem.headline: Digitel sees H1 net almost doubling.

text.p: Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc (Digitel) will likely post "over 500 million pesos" in net income for the first half of the year, an official said on Wednesday.
"The indication is that the increase would be almost 100 percent for the first half," Digitel senior vice-president William Pamintuan told Reuters.
Pamintuan said a bigger subscriber base would account for the expected higher profits in the first six months.
Digitel subscribers now number 118,000 from the 80,000 as of the end of 1996, he said.
